name: conversation-history
title: Conversation history
description: Past AI chats grouped by when they happened — pinned first, then today, yesterday, the last week and earlier months — with the open chat filled and a menu on each row to rename, pin or delete it.

meta.use_when: People come back to earlier conversations with an AI and need to find one, reopen it, and tidy the list.
meta.not_for: you want the whole chat page; it carries a short list of its own → ai-chat; the side column moves between sections of the app, not between past chats → sidebar-nav; people look a chat up by typing its name instead of browsing by date → command-palette

docs: Past AI chats grouped by when they happened — pinned first, then today, yesterday, the last week and earlier months — with the open chat filled and a menu on each row to rename, pin or delete it. Do: Pass your chats as conversations and wire onSelect, onRename, onPin and onDelete. The five chats shown without it are sample content. Don't: Ship the sample list, or edit the block to hard-code yours — the block is overwritten on update. Do: Leave both steps in: the confirmation before, and Undo in the list for a few seconds after. onDelete is called once the Undo time has passed. Don't: Delete on the first press, or delete on your side before onDelete is called — Undo could not bring the chat back. Do: Leave out a callback you do not support; its menu item is not drawn. Don't: Pass a callback that does nothing so the menu looks complete. Do: Open this list from the AI side panel's History button (onHistory), in your own sheet or column. Don't: Expect the side panel to show it by itself — the panel does not hold a history view. Use ai-chat when you want the whole chat page; it carries a short list of its own. Use sidebar-nav when the side column moves between sections of the app, not between past chats. Use command-palette when people look a chat up by typing its name instead of browsing by date.
